title: agent-rules-bench: where should a coding rule live for AI coding agents?
description:
The harness and the data of a controlled benchmark that compares two places for the same coding rule for AI coding agents: prose in Markdown instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) and lint rules with an in-session feedback loop.

It holds the study setups, the pre-registered analysis plans (Plans 6 and 7 are also registered on OSF: https://osf.io/9hdjs and https://osf.io/6v8yx), the prompts, the transcripts, diffs and logs of every run, the hand labels, the paper source, and the scripts that make every table and number of the paper again.
